item.title: The Streaming and the Dead
item.author: connor@loughondata.com (Connor Lough)
item.description: Streaming has become a must-have data engineering skill, even when batch is still the right architecture. So I built a Kafka and Flink lab on top of Rufous web analytics to find out what the job descriptions are really asking for.
